clean_task.detail: The governed CPU probe ran through the typed Provider (JobRequestV1 to handle to result) on an x86_64 CPU node; perf_event_open opened cycles and instructions under policy level 0 and both counters read back. No sudo was used and no security setting was changed. The recorded artifact is byte-identical to the job's own declared output pin.

provider_portability.detail: Provider independence was established by withdrawing the incumbent ari.provider.coding and re-offering the identical capability contracts under the reserved stand-in identity ari.provider.synthetic-substitute. All 3 capabilities the incumbent had won rebound, deterministically, and none stayed bound to the incumbent. No second implementation was executed, so this is not cross-Provider portability: it shows only that the requirement set names capabilities rather than a Provider. The report is stored beside this file as evidence/intel_linux_perf.abstraction.json.
